nodes.label: CFA Institute
nodes.description: Organization that establishes the Code of Ethics and Standards of Professional Conduct for investment professionals.

nodes.label: Code of Ethics
nodes.description: Set of ethical principles guiding CFA members and candidates to act with integrity, competence, and professionalism.

nodes.label: Standards of Professional Conduct
nodes.description: Detailed rules and guidelines that CFA members and candidates must follow in their professional activities.

nodes.label: Members and Candidates
nodes.description: Individuals who hold CFA designation or are pursuing it, required to adhere to the Code and Standards.

nodes.label: Integrity
nodes.description: Core value requiring honesty and ethical behavior in all professional activities.

nodes.label: Professionalism
nodes.description: Requirement to act competently, diligently, and ethically while complying with laws and regulations.

nodes.label: Independence and Objectivity
nodes.description: Obligation to maintain unbiased judgment and avoid conflicts of interest.

nodes.label: Confidential Information
nodes.description: Sensitive client or market information that must not be misused or disclosed improperly.

nodes.label: Market Integrity
nodes.description: Principle to avoid market manipulation and ensure fair and transparent capital markets.

nodes.label: Obligations to Clients
nodes.description: Duties including loyalty, prudence, fair treatment, suitability, confidentiality, and accurate performance reporting.

nodes.label: Obligations to Employers
nodes.description: Responsibilities to act loyally, avoid conflicts of interest, and supervise compliance within the workplace.

nodes.label: Investment Analysis, Recommendations, and Decisions
nodes.description: Requirement to apply diligence, reasonable judgment, and clear communication in investment activities.

nodes.label: Conflicts of Interest
nodes.description: Situations that may impair objective decision-making, requiring full disclosure and prioritization of client and employer interests.

nodes.label: Disciplinary Measures
nodes.description: Actions taken by CFA Institute against members or candidates who violate the Code or Standards, including revocation of membership or designation.

nodes.label: Responsibilities as CFA Member or Candidate
nodes.description: Obligations to uphold the reputation and integrity of the CFA Institute, designation, and programs.
